finding.summary: A replaced image reuses its per-frame ordinal ImageKey with new pixels and a fresh Blob; NetRender keeps the old pixels.
evidence: Paint list carries the replacement pixels (asserted); scene gets a fresh blob id (3) for the same ImageKey 0x8000000000000001 with 8x8 size.
Same scene on a fresh surface key still draws blue (probe image 2b): staleness is renderer-wide, not per-surface tile state.

netrender d92050146 vello_rasterizer/mod.rs CpuImageCache::refresh: entries.entry(key).or_insert_with(..); documented as 'Keys identify immutable pixels until absent from a refreshed scene'. Its debug_assert compares only width/height/length and is compiled out in release (here dimensions changed 16x16 -> 8x8, so a debug build would assert).
Genet side: paint.rs image_key_for allocates ordinal images.len()+1 per list, so the same slot gets the same key across frames whatever its pixels.
finding.owner_fork: Answered by Mark, 2026-10-20: "netrender side sounds cool, with blob identity as the comparator". Fix is in NetRender CpuImageCache::refresh; not yet made.
